Subject: Quick ask: short hosted-api privacy FAQ + technical appendix

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team liked the deterministic latency and routing examples. Before we loop procurement/legal, our legal team asked for two small deliverables to include with the SOW: a one-paragraph consumer-facing privacy summary for our procurement portal and a short technical appendix that diagrams data flows and lists current subprocessors (they want a CSV). Ideally both should be short (FAQ-style, ~3–5 bullets for the consumer blurb; appendix can be a page with a simple diagram + subprocessor table).

Can you get us a draft by next Wednesday (6/16)? We don’t need the final DPA redlines yet — just the public-facing bits so internal stakeholders can greenlight the purchase. If you already have templates, that would help accelerate things.

Thanks,
Sam

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API short summary + appendix — suggested edits

Mina / Laura — quick notes on the draft:

1) Consumer blurb: shorten to 2–3 bullets, avoid legalese (e.g., replace "processing" with "use" where it doesn't change meaning). Suggest: 1) what we collect, 2) why we collect it (service delivery + quality), 3) how customers control retention/exports. Example below.

2) Technical appendix: add a tiny ASCII flow diagram and a one-line description of cross-border transfer safeguards (standard contractual clauses + region pinning options). That will answer the procurement checklist item without opening DPA redlines.

3) Subprocessor CSV: add a column, "data category" (tokens | telemetry | billing) and a "contracted access?" boolean column. Remove internal vendor notes.

Draft consumer blurb (2 bullets):
- Redwood hosts customer requests to generate responses using models; we only store request data if a customer enables retention for debugging or evals.
- Customers can choose where their data is processed (regions where we operate) and export or delete retained data via the Console or API.

I’ll mark these in the MD file and push an updated CSV. Laura — any regulatory flags you want added?

Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Product, Redwood Inference
